pages.text: $(li)Connect flux points to $(o)half$() draconic wireless crystals—not full crystals—or the connection fails.$(li)Draconic Fusion Crafting: Package Crafter + Distributor;

mark the first distributor on the fusion core, set crafting injectors to single-item mode, trigger with a wireless transmitter + comparator or a redstone clock, and keep the unpackager in blocking mode.$(li)Don't automate dragon steel pre-fusion (fire dragon blood is scarce);
batch-craft dreaded steel instead, and trade villagers for ice blood for the crucible.$(li)Never automate draconic reactor explosions—huge TPS lag and possible crashes.

$(li)Thaumcraft infusion: an Autonomous Activator (or Mechanical User) holding the Thaumonomicon starts the craft; item conduits place pedestal items and essentia comes in separately. Setups may reset on server restart, and research can't be done by fake players.
$(li)For ME/Cyclic multiblock automation, use 53 import buses per multiblock and 1 partitioned cell per essentia type.$(li)You can tick-accelerate the Gateway Core.

$(li)Astral Sorcery Iridescent Altar via Integrated Dynamics: read $(5)craftingData$() for the item type (heart vs. statue via $(5)index % 2$()) and relay position ($(5)bposX$(), $(5)bposZ$()); skip items already present, find inputs by NBT position, and fetch only missing items.

$(li)Exporters must check the custom NBT (coordinates) subset match and that the target is empty before exporting 1 item; re-place cables now and then to avoid sync issues.$(li)Give incense sticks their own Mechanical User, off the impulse hopper path, to prevent jams.
